verdict.rationale: The only relevant evidence is a product-page line saying data goes to your team and, "where you choose," to scoped research partnerships. That implies sharing data beyond your team is opt-in, but it never says AI model training is excluded or can be turned off. Missing for 10: an explicit no-training or opt-out policy, documentation of how training opt-out controls work, any statement on whether the AI assistant or ML recommendations train on customer data, and independent corroboration.
